name: # where today's pieces are in the repository: a folder that moves is one line here
REPO_IMAGE
note: build.py (the bundle), gameinput.py

name: REPO_SWITCHES
note: the released module's switches: n6's with the machines' lanes (0.3.0 on; review 037's 82b7241c)

name: RELEASE_CODEGEN_REV
note: the DOLRECOMP_CODEGEN_REV of the module the last review proved: scripts/release-build.sh refuses switches that give another

name: REPO_BUILD
note: the step scripts, cmake/ (the superbuild's recipes; CMakeLists.txt and CMakePresets.json are at the root), win/tools.bat, manifest.py (fastlookup.py is the recompiler fork's: forks/dolrecomp, tools/)

name: REPO_FORKS
note: upstream.tsv is the one table of the source trees (our fork's URL, upstream base, our commit, tree id), each a submodule here; apply.sh checks a tree out in a work folder, check.sh --trees checks a work folder's

name: REPO_MACHINE
note: the machine files in use

name: # the other parts' checkouts, relative to this repository's root (port/setup/app.sh and parts.py read them): the protocol is this repository's submodule; the launcher and the service are checkouts beside this one, as they are cloned next to it
REPO_SERVICE
note: the service: the test server and the simulated players, their build

name: REPO_LAUNCHER
note: the launcher: what a staged or packed launcher is published from, its fonts, icon and SDK

name: REPO_PROTOCOL
note: the protocol: its schema and generated files

name: REPO_TOOLS
note: piconet-tools, as the launcher is built with it: the launcher's submodule (its Fzgx.GameCube reads the player's disc); package.sh asks its git users for the names no copy may hold

name: REPO_GATES
note: the gates (piconet-gates, private): a checkout of them here, where their own pins.tsv says REPO_RUNNER ../..; they hold the test harness (vendor/harness, copied from recomp-kit: its win/launch.ps1 starts every test game, install.sh copies win/ to kit-win; RECOMP_KIT=<a recomp-kit checkout> takes that one's tools/harness) and this PC's locks. Optional: a checkout without them builds and runs its core tests, and says what it leaves out

name: PC_SCRIPTS_DEFAULT
note: the folder of a PC's own scripts (its locks, the busy check, the quiet check; no repository holds them), which port/setup/lib.sh pc_take sources where they are: empty here, a row of ~/.config/piconet/pins.tsv names it (PC_SCRIPTS in the environment over it). Without it a build and the gates run all the same, and say once what is left out

name: # the tools: which version a build needs, never where it is. port/setup/tools.py finds each as its own documented way does (Visual Studio by vswhere, LLVM and Python on PATH or the py launcher, cmake and ninja on PATH); a PC that keeps one elsewhere names it in ~/.config/piconet/pins.tsv, a table of this form outside every checkout read over this one (port/setup/lib.sh): TOOL_VCVARS_WIN (the vcvars64.bat), TOOL_LLVM_WIN, TOOL_PYTHON_WIN (the folders)
VERSION_VS
note: Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools (17.x; vswhere's -version range) with the C++ workload; n6: MSVC 14.44.35207

name: VERSION_LLVM
note: LLVM for Windows with lib/cmake (the recompiler links it): clang+llvm-20.1.8-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, github.com/llvm/llvm-project releases

name: VERSION_PYTHON
note: Python for Windows, python.org (the module's build runs it)

name: VERSION_CMAKE
note: cmake on PATH: the version module n6 was built with (another is said, not refused)

name: VERSION_NINJA
note: ninja on PATH (or in Python's Scripts: pip install ninja): the version module n6 was built with (another is said, not refused)

name: TOOL_GIT
note: Git for Windows on PATH: forks/check.sh reads a work folder's trees with it (the checkouts themselves are made by Linux git, forks/apply.sh); n6: 2.42.0

name: # the disc and what is made from it: hashes only, the files stay in the work folder. Your own disc image is a setting with no default: a row DISC_DEFAULT<tab>/mnt/c/.../F-Zero GX (USA).iso in ~/.config/piconet/pins.tsv
SHA1_MAIN_DOL
note: sys/main.dol as the disc has it

note: files/fze.sample.rel as the disc has it

name: SHA1_MAIN_REL
note: derived/main.rel

name: SHA1_MOVIE
note: derived/loaded-05-movie.bin
